# Faith & West

- [Faith](../character/faith.md) — Friend of — [West](../character/west.md) — confidante and sympathetic friend · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XX. FAITH MAKES A FRIEND P17](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0017)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#the-meredith) children finalize the rules for their new Good-[Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club), agreeing to hold themselves accountable and punish bad behavior to protect their father's reputation. After signing the club's document in the graveyard, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) expresses her fear to [Faith](../character/faith.md) that their father might marry Miss [West](../character/west.md) and become a stepmother, influenced by Mary Vance's horror stories.
